title: DNS name resolution
description: Explain, observe, diagnose and repair how a host turns a name into an address: the application calls the C library resolver, which consults `/etc/hosts`, reads `/etc/resolv.conf` and sends DNS queries over UDP/TCP port 53 to the configured nameservers, which answer from their zones or by recursion. Mastery means locating the failing hop with evidence (configuration, live queries, packets, listening sockets) and fixing the cause, not the symptom.
